description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，且起止时间的范围不能超过1天（推荐范围为1小时），格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed one day. We recommend that you specify 1 hour. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
实例中的节点ID。传入本参数可查询指定节点的慢日志信息。
> 当实例的架构为读写分离或集群架构时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The ID of the node in the instance. You can set this parameter to query the slow query logs of a specified node.

>  This parameter is available only for read/write splitting and cluster instances.

description.zh:
返回结果的排序依据，取值：
* **execution_time**：默认值，按照请求的执行开始时间排序。
* **latency**：按照请求的执行耗时排序。
description.en:
The dimension by which to sort the results. Default value: execution_time. Valid values:

*   **execution_time**: sorts the results by query start time.
*   **latency**: sorts the results by query latency.

description.zh:
返回结果的排序方式，取值：
* **ASC**：升序。
* **DESC**：默认值，降序。
description.en:
The sorting order of the results to return. Default value: DESC. Valid values:

*   **ASC**: ascending order
*   **DESC**: descending order

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于**0**且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than **0**. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.

description.zh: 可设置一个字符串类型的值，使用该值作为关键词对返回结果进行搜索。
description.en: The keyword based on which slow logs are queried. You can set this parameter to a value of the string type.

description.zh:
慢日志类型，取值：
* **proxy**：代理节点中的慢日志。
* **db**：默认值，数据节点中的慢日志。
description.en:
The type of the slow logs. Default value: db. Valid values:

*   **proxy**: slow logs of proxy nodes
*   **db**: slow logs of data nodes
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.zh:
该API对应的控制台操作请参见[查询慢日志](~~95874~~)。
DescribeSlowLogRecords的调用频率上限为100次/分钟。
descriptions.en: You can also query slow logs in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console. For more information, see [Query slow logs of an instance](~~95874~~). This operation can be called up to 100 times per minute.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-slow-log-records --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --node-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0 --start-time 2019-03-10T14:00Z --end-time 2019-03-10T15:00Z --db-name 0 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --slow-log-record-type proxy --query-keyword keyword1 --order-type ASC --order-by execution_time --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeSlowLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy execution_time --OrderType ASC --EndTime '2019-03-10T15:00Z' --PageSize 30 --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --PageNumber 1 --SlowLogRecordType proxy --NodeId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0' --StartTime '2019-03-10T14:00Z' --DBName 0 --QueryKeyword keyword1
